def T(t,nu,N=40):

    X,Y=np.meshgrid(a,a); P=np.stack([X.ravel()/np.sqrt(t)*1.0, Y.ravel()*np.sqrt(t)],1)  # tau=it, Im=t: (1, i t)/sqrt t
    P=np.stack([X.ravel()/np.sqrt(t),Y.ravel()*np.sqrt(t)],1)

    return s
